reason: I pay for Thumbtack leads and every one I lose hurts, so I'm not letting a bot talk to them when nobody outside the company that built it has used it. Maybe I'd poke at the free trial on a slow week, but I'm not signing up to pay.
objection: The AI answers a customer something dumb and I lose a $2,000 job I paid for the lead on. And there are no other customers using it yet, so I'd be the guinea pig.
would_change_my_mind: A few real contractors like me, with names I can call, saying it answered their leads without screwing up. Or a setup where it only texts back 'got your request, we'll call you in 10 minutes' and I approve anything else.
